limitations: Simulation only, not scored; a counterfactual through a model fitted on 2015-2025 DEV weeks, not a forecast.

The shift is applied to the degree-day inputs only; supply, LNG exports and prices are not shocked, and no feedback from price to demand is modelled. The response is the model's learned (monotone) weather sensitivity, extrapolated if +2 sd lies outside the training range for that week.
Daily flows are latent: EIA publishes only weekly totals, so the daily path is not validated against data; each path's daily flows are rescaled to sum to its weekly draw.

Uncertainty = CPC forecast-error noise on forecast days + the model's quantile spread; parameter uncertainty is only represented by the 3 seed members. Quantiles from the same model were only checked on DEV/VAL.
The direct twin also takes weather as input and can be shocked the same way; the WM's addition is the daily latent state path, not the ability to answer what-if questions per se.
